about: Limits for studio2/story-audit.mjs, taken from the reference clip (QlDPMzGmYac, 63.2 s). The numbers are measured by rea-video (rea/breakdown.json) and by the beat table in editorial-beats.json (22 beats). rea-video's guess of the picture type (it says live action) is wrong for this clip and is NOT used. A limit is the reference value with a margin, not a target to copy. Added from DEEP-ANALYSIS.md: maxFacts 2 (reference teaches 1), minCarrierShare 0.4 (the loop is in about half the beats), factRevealRange 0.4-0.8 (reference reveals the rule at 65%).
